nodes.text: 1. Form 3 of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure scheme will be enabled shortly

2. Due dates for filing of Income Tax Returns and Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 are extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 vide Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026.
3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

A registered design protects the , helping businesses, manufacturers, and designers safeguard the appearance of their products from unauthorized copying. In India, design registration is governed by the  and the applicable Designs Rules.

Design registration protects the visual features of an article, including its , as applied to an article. Registration gives the proprietor statutory protection against unauthorized application of the registered design, subject to applicable law.
shape, configuration, pattern, ornamentation, or composition of lines or colours
Provides statutory protection for the registered design.
Helps prevent unauthorized copying of the product's visual appearance.
A registered design is an intellectual property asset that may be assigned or licensed.
Registration provides official evidence of the proprietor's rights.
Protects original product designs and supports creative development.
Helps businesses distinguish their products through distinctive visual designs.
It should not have been previously published or used in the relevant manner before the filing/priority date.
The design should relate to the visual appearance of the article.
It must be applied to an article capable of industrial or manufacturing production.
Protection relates to visual features of the article and not merely its functional or mechanical features.
The design must not fall within the exclusions under the Designs Act, 2000.
A preliminary search and review helps assess whether the design appears eligible and sufficiently distinctive.
The application is prepared with the required representations, applicant details, statement of novelty, classification, and other prescribed information.
The Controller of Designs examines the application. If objections are raised, the applicant may submit a response or make permitted amendments.
Once the application satisfies the applicable requirements, the design is registered and details are published in the .
A certificate of registration is issued to the registered proprietor.
Design registration in India is initially valid for  and may generally be extended once for an additional , subject to the prescribed requirements and fee.
